summary: Ruanyun Edai Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching press releases about its Saudi subsidiary signing an MOU with Wadi Makkah Technology Company, a wholly owned subsidiary of Umm Al-Qura University. The MOU is a preliminary framework to explore potential cooperation in AI education, language testing, training, research, joint investments, and market initiatives in Saudi Arabia. No binding terms, financial amounts, or definitive agreements are disclosed. The filing reflects a routine business development update, not a special situation. As a non-US filing mapped to a current report on Form 6-K, it reports an ordinary strategic alliance exploration.
